title: Tape Measure

fields.label: Function
fields.value: Measure the size of schematics and objects

body:
"Can be used to determine the size of schematics on your property, leaving this item in your toolbar while using buildmode will display the scale while your building as well"

The Tape Measure is a tool that can be bought from Illumine Designs for the time being for $5,580. It allows the holder to see the size of schematics or structures.

Description

The Tape Measure allows the user to see the size of any schematic or structure they have their mouse cursor over. This appears as a light blue rectangle over the schematic or structure with the stud measurements of its size. While outside of build mode, the user must hold the Tape Measure in order to see the pop-up; while in build mode, as long as the Tape Measure is in the user's inventory, these measurements will appear when hovering over any schematic or structure, and will stay pinned when that schematic or structure is selected.

Trivia

  • This tool was previously priced at $12,580.
